Nora (People Ops): @here Heads-up: All-hands Friday 11:00 AM PT. Agenda + quick Q form: https://forms.gle/redwood-ah-4312 — please add anything urgent by Thu 3 PM.
Andre Vogel (CEO): I'll open with company pulse + where we stand on Dedicated ramp (5m).
Priya Desai (Product): I'll present the final beta checklist and show perf numbers (8m). Deck will be uploaded Thu.
Kai Lopez (Eng): I'll cover a short postmortem on the deploy incident and the follow-up mitigation we implemented (5m).
Jared (SRE): Adding a quick note on observability improvements: new end-to-end tracing for request routing.
Marta (Customer Success): Request: include 3 customer blurbs for the launch slides. Pinged the accounts.
Nora (People Ops): Format: 35 min total. 15m exec+product, 8m eng/sre, 7m customer, 10m live Q&A. Recording & transcript will be posted.
allhands-bot: :bell: Reminder set — All-hands Fri 11:00 AM PT. Calendar invite updated.
Priya Desai (Product): Deck link (v0): https://redwood.share/drive/ah-dedicated-beta-v0 — will revise Thu evening.
Kai Lopez (Eng): Incident TL;DR: misrouted traffic during a config rollout. Fixed with a canary gate + automated validation.
Nora (People Ops): Please post 1-2 priority Qs in the form or here by Thu 3 PM so we can queue them for the panel.
Nora (People Ops): (after meeting) Recording: https://redwood.co/recordings/4312345678-allhands. Key takeaways posted below.
Nora (People Ops): TAKEAWAYS: 1) Dedicated beta on-track for May; invites for pilot customers next week. 2) SLA goal for pilot: 99.95% on critical routes. 3) Deploy incident mitigated; canary gating and config validation added. 4) CS to provide three customer vignettes for launch comms. Actions and owners documented in the follow-up doc.
Andre Vogel (CEO): Appreciate the tight updates. Follow-ups to be tracked with owners; will check progress in 4 weeks.
Marta (Customer Success): Customer blurbs confirmed (two startup, one enterprise) 1: will add to the deck.
Jared (SRE): Observability changes are live; posting runbook changes in Confluence.
Nora (People Ops): Closing: action list posted in the follow-up doc, will copy into #all-hands. :white_check_mark:
